purpose: Teach: 不本意/産出/公国/喘息/仰天/変異/転覆/大麻

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、不本意な役職に就いた人物史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on reluctant leaders throughout history, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. Gentle confirmation rather than interrogation. Steady eye contact, slightly raised eyebrows—noticing something interesting. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、資源産出地域の経済史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I focused on the economic history of resource-producing regions.
lines.style: Clear and direct, meeting her gaze. A small pause before responding—not defensive, just taking the question seriously. Measured pace, grounded tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ヨーロッパの公国の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ah, and the history of European principalities caught your attention?
lines.style: Thoughtful recalibration. Slight tilt of head, as if reconsidering. Warm curiosity without pressure. The tone of someone making a mental note and genuinely interested.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、都市部の喘息発症率を論文で扱いました
lines.en: No, actually—I researched asthma rates in urban populations.
lines.style: Patient but assured. Not correcting sharply, just offering the facts clearly. Slight firmness on the opening word, like gently insisting on accuracy.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史的事件の仰天証言を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And startling historical testimony seemed central to your research?
lines.style: Engaged and leaning forward slightly. A note of genuine wonder in the voice. Warmer now—recognizing the scope of what she's exploring. Collaborative tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、ウイルスの変異研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: I actually investigated viral mutation and evolution.
lines.style: Calm, not rattled. A small smile in the tone—understanding the pattern now. Speaking with quiet confidence, matching her curiosity with her own knowledge.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近代の政府転覆事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Government overthrows in the modern period seemed important to your work?
lines.style: Reflective and slight amusement underneath. Knowing pause, like she's enjoying this. Warmer now, almost conspiratorial—two people noticing something together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、大麻を巡る法政策史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: My focus was on cannabis law and policy throughout modern history.
lines.style: Steady, unbothered. A hint of wry amusement—she's caught onto what Asuka is doing. Direct, confident, ending with a slight lift—open, not defensive.
